channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio faz live com Padre Kelmon e pai de santo de Anitta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign held a live stream with religious leaders, including Father Kelmon and pai de santo Sérgio Pina, amid rumors about Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Aliados de Lula criticam Mendonça por tirar do ar fake news sobre padroeira
item.description: Lula's allies criticized TSE Minister André Mendonça for ordering the removal of posts containing fake news about Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly planning to remove Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint. They deemed the decision censorship and questioned electoral interference.

item.title: A uma semana da eleição, campanhas de Lula e Flávio Bolsoanro tentam alcançar indecisos
item.description: One week before the runoff, the campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) intensify efforts to win over undecided voters and mobilize their bases amid high polarization and political tension. The final stretch is marked by targeted communication strategies and the need to avoid negative events that could shift the agenda.

item.title: Fake sobre N.S Aparecida tem 1 milhão de posts e vira 3ª maior repercussão do ano nas redes
item.description: A false claim linking senator Flávio Bolsonaro to a bill revoking Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint generated 977.6 thousand social media posts in 55 hours, becoming the third biggest political topic of 2026. The misinformation, spread by pro-government influencers, sparked 8.5 million interactions and fueled religious and electoral debates.

item.title: Desaprovação do STF atinge nível máximo no País, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Disapproval of STF ministers reached 47%, the highest in history, according to Datafolha. The increase is linked to revelations of possible connections between ministers and Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. Among Lula voters, 32% approve of the STF, while among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, only 6% approve.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda suspender jingle de Lula “foi o Flávio Bolsonaro”
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, provisionally suspended a campaign jingle by Lula that links Flávio Bolsonaro to corruption schemes, as it contains distorted information and may mislead voters. The minister emphasized that the song's catchy and repetitive format could cause irreversible damage during the electoral period by presenting unproven or already dismissed facts.

item.title: Uma eleição do ‘menos pior’, mas disputada pau a pau
item.description: The 2026 election is portrayed as a tight 'lesser of two evils' race devoid of popular enthusiasm. Both outcomes — a Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula victory — forecast institutional crisis, a weakened executive, STF tensions, and corruption probes targeting candidates' families and allies. Despite political risks, the text underscores Brazil's economic strength driven by agribusiness, renewable energy, and natural resources.

item.title: A dura avaliação dos eleitores sobre o Supremo Tribunal Federal, segundo pesquisa
item.description: Datafolha survey reveals that 47% of Brazilians negatively assess the work of the STF, the worst index in the historical series (2019-2026). Among Lula supporters, 32% view the STF positively; among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, only 6% consider the ministers' work good or excellent, with 69% expressing negative views. Registered with the TSE, the poll also shows 45% of voters support creating an Ethics Code for STF ministers.

item.title: Quaest: Lula atinge 40%, Flávio marca 35% e Cury tem 7% no Pará
item.description: Quaest poll shows Lula leading with 40% of voting intentions in Pará, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 35% and Augusto Cury with 7% for the first round. The margin of error is 3 percentage points, with 83% of voters stating their choice is final.

item.title: Zema e Renan dizem que proibição das bets de Lula é medida eleitoreira
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) and Renan Santos (Missão) criticized Lula's MP 1.394/2026 banning bets, calling it an electioneering move before the first round. Both agree online betting harms families but question the electoral timing of the prohibition.

item.title: “Aberração eleitoral”, diz Zema sobre medidas anunciadas por Lula
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) classified the Lula administration's recent measures, including the betting ban, as an 'electoral aberration' and accused the president of political opportunism on the eve of the 2026 election.

item.title: Datafolha: 37% avaliam trabalho do Congresso Nacional como ruim ou péssimo
item.description: Datafolha poll reveals 37% of voters rate Congress as bad or terrible, while 18% see it as excellent or good. Among Lula voters, 22% view Congress positively; among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, only 15% do.

item.title: Quaest no Pará: 47% aprovam e 25% desaprovam governo de Hana Ghassan (MDB)
item.description: A new Quaest poll in Pará shows that 47% of voters approve of Governor Hana Ghassan's (MDB) administration, while 25% disapprove, according to a survey conducted between September 22 and 25. The main concern among voters is healthcare (37%), followed by violence (12%) and infrastructure (7%). The poll had a margin of error of 3 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Quaest no Pará: Lula, 40%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 35%; Augusto Cury, 7%; Renan Santos, 2%; Ronaldo Caiado, 2%
item.description: Quaest poll in Pará shows Lula (PT) at 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35% for 2026 presidential race. Both grew since August, polarizing the state contest. Undecided dropped to 10% and 83% say their choice is final.

item.title: Datafolha: Congresso tem avaliação melhor entre eleitores de Lula
item.description: A Datafolha poll released less than a week before the elections shows 37% of voters have a negative assessment of the National Congress, 18% consider it great or good, and 40% rate it as regular. Congress's assessment is better among Lula's voters, maintaining the same levels recorded in May. The survey also reveals that 55% of voters intend to cast a blank protest vote in the first round.

item.title: Vorcaro transforma MPF e STF de instituições em corporações
item.description: Aniel Vorcaro, former CVM president, criticized the Supreme Federal Court (STF) and the Attorney General's Office (PGR) by treating institutions as corporations, using highly anti-establishment rhetoric. His speech, marked by direct attacks on ministers and state figures, reflects a right-wing ideological positioning strategy focused on privatizations and institutional control. The content generated mixed reactions, with some sectors of society supporting him as a defender of economic freedom, while others accuse him of promoting destabilization.

item.title: Nikolas diz que Lula deixará bets voltarem após eleição
item.description: Federal Congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) claimed that President Lula decided to ban sports betting for electoral reasons and that the temporary measure will be repealed after the 2026 elections. He suggested the ban is politically motivated and that betting will resume in 2027.

item.title: Datafolha: avaliação negativa de ministros do STF bate recorde com 47%
item.description: Negative evaluation of the STF ministers' work reached 47%, the highest level since 2019, according to a Datafolha survey. Among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, 69% rate the Court negatively, while among Lula supporters, 24% are negative. The survey was conducted between September 22 and 23 with 2,002 voters and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Eleitor deve se antecipar na consulta a local de votação, alerta TSE
item.description: As the 2026 elections approach, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) warns voters to verify their polling location, as their section may have changed since the last election. Changes affect thousands of voters, including 670,000 in Rio de Janeiro, with 72 locations modified for security reasons. Voters can check their address through the e-Título app or the TSE Portal.

item.title: O embate Lula X Flávio Bolsonaro no terceiro maior colégio do Nordeste, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 60% support in Ceará, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 26%. The poll, with a two-point margin of error, also indicates Elmano de Freitas (PT) leading the gubernatorial race with 48% against 41% for Ciro Gomes.

item.title: Com bets nas camisas, São Paulo vence Corinthians no feminino
item.description: São Paulo defeated Corinthians 2-1 in the first match of the Brazilian Women's Championship final, with both teams featuring sports betting sponsors. President Lula signed a provisional measure banning sports betting in Brazil, requiring removal of sponsorships by October 5.

item.title: Datafolha: 47% dos brasileiros reprovam ministros do STF; índice é o pior desde 2019
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on September 26, 2026, shows that 47% of Brazilians disapprove of the work of STF ministers, the highest rate since 2019. Disapproval is particularly strong among Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) voters, with 69% holding a negative view. A majority of respondents (45%) support the creation of an Ethics Code for STF ministers.

item.title: Pastor de Flávio Bolsonaro diz: “Deus odeia o culto à Rainha dos Céus”
item.description: Bishop JB Carvalho, leader of the church attended by Flávio Bolsonaro, condemns devotion to the Queen of Heaven in his 2001 book, labeling it idolatry. Bolsonaro stated that if elected, he will declare Brazil as the Lord's land, aligning with evangelical doctrine and drawing criticism from Catholic faithful. His relationship with Carvalho’s religious institution intensified following his 2024 baptism at Comunidade das Nações.

item.title: 37% avaliam Congresso como ruim ou péssimo, aponta Datafolha; 18% dizem que desempenho é ótimo ou bom
item.description: A September 2026 Datafolha poll reveals that 37% of Brazilian voters rate Congress's performance as bad or very bad, while only 18% consider it good or excellent. Approval varies by presidential vote preference, region, and income, being higher among Lula supporters (22%) and lower among Flávio Bolsonaro supporters (15%). Men and individuals earning above five minimum wages are more critical compared to women and lower-income populations.

item.title: Quem quer ganhar dinheiro deve buscar ‘jeito honesto’, diz Lula um dia após proibir bets
item.description: President Lula defended the ban on online betting (bets) during a campaign event in São Paulo, stating that those who want to make money should do so honestly. He emphasized that bets worsen poverty and indebtedness among families, citing losses of R$62.5 billion in 2025. The government issued a provisional measure to prohibit the exploitation, offering, intermediation, and advertising of bets in the country.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira diz que Lula vai liberar bets depois das eleições
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) accused President Lula of banning online betting sites for electoral reasons, suggesting the measure will be reversed after the elections. He claimed, without evidence, that Congress will let MP 1.394 of 2026 expire to prevent the permanent ban.

item.title: Avaliação negativa do STF bate recorde no Datafolha
item.description: Negative evaluation of STF ministers' performance reached 47%, the highest since the series began in 2019, according to Datafolha. In May, 40% rated the Court's performance as bad or very bad, while positive assessment stood at 18%, tied for the lowest result. The survey does not mention specific candidates but reflects growing dissatisfaction with the Supreme Court.

item.title: Flávio aposta em ataques a Lula, voto útil e Sudeste no fim do 1º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is gearing up for a more aggressive final stretch of the first round, targeting direct attacks on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and pushing for the useful vote. The strategy includes revisiting corruption cases involving Lula's associates and highlighting issues like household debt and public security. The goal is to surpass Lula in the October 4th elections to strengthen his candidacy for the second round.

item.title: Reta final do 1º turno: Lula faz giro nas regiões e intensifica mobilização
item.description: In the final week before the first round, Lula intensifies travel across the North, Northeast, and Southeast, focusing on the Southeast. The PT launches the "Bora, Lula" national mobilization with over 500 activities nationwide, while the president cancels a trip to Manaus and prepares for the TV Globo presidential debate.

item.title: As primeiras pesquisas sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio após a proibição das bets
item.description: The BTG/Nexus and Quaest surveys, released Monday 28th, will be the first to capture voter reactions to Lula's announced ban on sports betting, with fieldwork conducted after the announcement. The policy, set to take effect October 6th, will be assessed as a potential impact factor in the tight race between Lula and Flávio, according to recent polls.

item.title: Datafolha: avaliação negativa do STF sobe para 47% e bate recorde
item.description: Negative evaluation of the STF ministers rose from 40% in May to 47% in September 2026, reaching a historical record since 2019 according to Datafolha poll. Rejection of the Supreme Court's work increased significantly during the period.

item.title: Enquanto prega voto útil, Flávio Bolsonaro calcula riscos de 2º turno contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro intensifies the campaign for a unified right-wing vote in October, but faces risks from ongoing investigations into the 'Dark Horse' film, which could impact his campaign against Lula in a potential second round.

item.title: Influenciadores postam manifesto em defesa das bets
item.description: Digital influencers with millions of followers, such as JoJo Todynho, Jon Vlogs, and Davi Brito, published a manifesto defending the regulated betting market against the executive order signed by Lula that bans the sector. The movement, summarized by the hashtag #NósApostamosNoBrasil, advocates for maintaining regulation and warns that prohibition may drive betting to illegal platforms.

item.title: Judeus bolsonaristas pregam boicote a eleitores de Lula na comunidade israelita
item.description: Bolsonarista Jews in the Israeli community circulated a boycott list of 1.306 Lula voters, including public figures like Lilia Schwarcz and Jayme Brener, following a manifesto supporting the re-election of the PT ticket. The list, shared via messaging apps, was condemned by its targets as a cowardly and authoritarian move akin to Nazi tactics.

item.title: ‘Dilma Bolada’ começou com fake sobre N. S. Aparecida, indica monitoramento da campanha de Flávio
item.description: A false claim that senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) intended to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as patron saint of Brazil originated from a post by influencer Jeferson de Oliveira Monteiro, author of the 'Dilma Bolada' account. Flávio's campaign tracked the misinformation, secured a TSE order to remove over 1,000 posts, and requested the detainment of the influencer, while government-aligned figures also spread the false narrative.

item.title: Tarcísio chama proibição das bets de 'oportunismo eleitoral' e diz que governo só agiu 'faltando nove dias para a eleição'
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized President Lula's announcement banning betting apps, labeling it electoral opportunism as it came nine days before the election. He attributed the population's debt to the federal economic policy and advocated for responsible discussion on the ban to avoid legal insecurity, despite being against gambling. Tarcísio also emphasized that Brazilians are resistant to electoral measures and need structural changes.

item.title: Tarcísio apoia fim das bets, mas vê “oportunismo eleitoral” de Lula
item.description: Tarcísio supports banning online betting but criticizes Lula's decision as electoral opportunism, coming just 9 days before the election. He expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro and André do Prado.

item.title: Flávio volta a chamar Lula de “pai do Tigrinho” mesmo após ação no TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro labeled Lula as the 'father of Tigrinho' and criticized online betting policies, while promising to combat militias and lower the age of criminal responsibility if elected. Lula's coalition filed a lawsuit with the TSE to counter Flávio's statements. He also announced appointments for health and security ministers, reinforcing an authoritarian tone.

item.title: Os políticos que ajudaram a bombar a fake news contra Flávio sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: A false news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro supported removing Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil’s patron saint went viral on social media despite being debunked. Left-wing politicians, including Erika Hilton and Ivan Valente, amplified the rumor, according to a Brandwatch ranking. The proposal was filed in 2007 and later archived, with Globonews issuing an apology for spreading the misinformation.

item.title: Paes faz maratona de agendas na Baixada para afagar aliados e aprova decisão de Lula contra Bets: ‘Virou problema de saúde pública’
item.description: Eduardo Paes held a campaign marathon in the Baixada Fluminense region to court political allies, notably praising Lula's ban on betting apps and framing it as a public health issue. Across stops in Duque de Caxas, Nova Iguaçu and Guapimirim, Paes promised rail repairs and hospital construction, even as he navigated support from Bolsonaro-aligned mayors.

item.title: AO VIVO: LULA NA ZONA LESTE DE SÃO PAULO (ELEIÇÕES 2026- NOTÍCIAS POLÍTICA)
item.description: Live broadcast of President Lula's event in Sao Paulo's East Zone, focusing on 2026 election arrangements. The video shows playback technical issues and YouTube privacy settings.

item.title: O placar da nova condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro no plenário do STF
item.description: The STF convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) to one year detention and an R$ 80,000 fine for defaming federal deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), in a 7-3 vote. The virtual plenary ruling, led by Justice Alexandre de Moraes, found his 2021 social media posts harmed her honor and were not protected by parliamentary immunity. Bolsonaro has been in the US since February 2025 and lost his seat due to excessive absences.

item.title: Após pedidos de PSD e MDB, Tebet distribui panfletos sem números de Lula, Haddad e Marina
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB), Senate candidate for São Paulo, distributed 1 million flyers excluding the image, name, and ballot number of Lula (PT), Fernando Haddad (PT), and Marina Silva (Rede). The move followed requests from PSD and MDB.

item.title: 'Em todo escândalo ele tem algum amigo', diz Haddad sobre Flávio Bolsonaro, após caminhada com Lula em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for not accounting for funding of the film 'Dark Horse', accusing him of being involved in corruption scandals. During a walk with Lula in São Paulo, Haddad also attacked Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and emphasized the importance of Lula's re-election.

item.title: Candidatos a presidente em 2026: veja nome e o número de cada um
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, 13 candidates compete for the Planalto, including Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and seven others, focusing on economy, security, and health.

item.title: Lula admite ‘atitude drástica’ contra bets, e Flávio chama rival de ‘desesperado’
item.description: President Lula defended a drastic measure against online betting, calling it a 'disaster' for the poor, while Flávio Bolsonaro harshly criticized him, calling him 'father of Tigrinho' and 'desperate'. The provisional measure signed by the government prohibits fixed-odds betting and online games in Brazil.

item.title: A resposta da Secom ao pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro por prisão de servidor
item.description: The Presidency's Communications Secretariat rejected the request for the arrest of Secom employee George Marques, stating that the reshare of fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida was made on a personal profile, outside work hours, and defended freedom of expression.

item.title: Lula intensifica agenda de rua na reta final do primeiro turno e faz corpo a corpo em SP
item.description: Lula intensified street-level campaigning ahead of the first round, focusing on direct voter engagement in São Paulo, paying attention to details like microphone volume and including allied candidates in the broadcast.

item.title: Bets começam a restringir cadastros após governo proibir apostas
item.description: The federal government banned, through a provisional decree (MP), the exploitation, supply, intermediation and advertising of online betting in Brazil. Platforms such as Betano, Bet365 and Superbet have already restricted new registrations and report that deposits will not be accepted, while withdrawals and bets remain available until October 5. The MP takes effect immediately, but must be approved by Congress within 120 days to become definitive.

item.title: Escudo das Américas: Flávio Bolsonaro promete adesão, enquanto especialista alerta para riscos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro promised to join the Americas Shield, a Donald Trump-led alliance targeting criminal groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho, criticizing Lula's public security policies. Experts warn of risks to Brazilian sovereignty if Washington-aligned governments conduct operations in the Amazon without national coordination.
